summary: Origin Agritech's indirect unit Beijing Origin Agriculture agreed on September 8, 2026 to sell 70.5184% of Xinjiang Originbo Seed Limited to Hunan Xindaxin for RMB 108 million (about US$15.0 million), based on a June 30, 2026 appraisal by Xinjiang Woshi. Payment comes in four installments through June 2027, with RMB 11.39 million of affiliate debt offset; title stays with the seller until full payment. Control transfers immediately, triggering deconsolidation, while a five-year leaseback at RMB 4 million annual rent preserves seed revenue. CEO Weibin Yan's 9.7549% stake in the buyer makes it a related-party transaction. Watch installment-collection and deconsolidation-gain risk.
